metadata.description: Evaluation dataset for Copilot v1 readiness. Tests correctness, groundedness, and citation accuracy.

tool_queries.query: What was the score of the Yankees vs Orioles game on September 15, 2026?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains score for Yankees vs Orioles on 2026-09-15

tool_queries.query: How many home runs did Mike Trout have in the 2024 season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains player stats including HR count for 2024

tool_queries.query: List the Los Angeles Dodgers games for September 2026
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains list of Dodgers games in September 2026
grounding_rules: Games must span the date range

tool_queries.query: What's Aaron Judge's batting average in the 2024 season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains Aaron Judge's batting average for 2024

tool_queries.query: How many RBIs does Juan Soto have this season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains Juan Soto's RBI count for 2026

tool_queries.query: What's the status of tonight's Red Sox game?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains game status (scheduled, live, final, etc.)

tool_queries.query: How many home runs has Bryce Harper hit this season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains Bryce Harper's HR count for 2026
grounding_rules: HR count must be accurate from StatsAPI

tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains list of teams/games scheduled for that date
grounding_rules: Games must be on specified date

tool_queries.query: Show me Mookie Betts' stats for 2024
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains comprehensive stats for Mookie Betts in 2024
grounding_rules: Must include HR, AVG, RBI metrics

tool_queries.query: Did the Boston Red Sox win their last game?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains whether Red Sox won/lost their most recent game
grounding_rules: Result must be from most recent completed game

tool_queries.query: What's Gerrit Cole's ERA this season?
How many wins does Shohei Ohtani have as a pitcher this season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains Shohei Ohtani's pitching wins for 2026
grounding_rules: Must filter for pitching stats (not hitting)

tool_queries.query: List all Toronto Blue Jays games for October 2026
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains list of Blue Jays games in October 2026
grounding_rules: Games must fall within October date range

tool_queries.query: What's the final score from yesterday's Yankees game?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains final score from Yankees' most recent game
grounding_rules: Must be from a completed/final game

tool_queries.query: How many strikeouts does Clayton Kershaw have this season?
tool_queries.expected_answer: Contains Clayton Kershaw's strikeout count for 2026

rag_queries.query: What is the infield fly rule in baseball?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Explains the infield fly rule and when it applies
grounding_rules: Must explain the rule's purpose and application

rag_queries.query: Explain the designated hitter rule in Major League Baseball
rag_queries.expected_answer: Describes the designated hitter rule and its history
grounding_rules: Should explain why the rule exists

rag_queries.query: What makes a strike in baseball?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Defines strike zone and what constitutes a strike

rag_queries.query: Explain what a double play is in baseball
rag_queries.expected_answer: Describes double play mechanics and examples

rag_queries.query: Who has hit the most home runs in World Series history?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Names player with most World Series home runs
grounding_rules: Must cite document source (history_records_achievements or history_world_series)

rag_queries.query: What is the all-time record for home runs in MLB?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Cites Barry Bonds's home run record
grounding_rules: Must name the record holder and count

rag_queries.query: What does WAR mean in baseball statistics?
grounding_rules: Should explain how it measures player value

rag_queries.query: How are MLB teams organized into divisions and leagues?

rag_queries.expected_answer: Names Los Angeles Dodgers as 2020 World Series winner

rag_queries.query: Explain sabermetrics and its impact on modern baseball
rag_queries.expected_answer: Discusses sabermetrics principles and MLB adoption
grounding_rules: Should explain how analytics changed the game

rag_queries.query: What is OPS and how is it calculated in baseball?
How many teams are in Major League Baseball?
What's the history of the World Series?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Provides overview of World Series history and significance
grounding_rules: Should mention founding year or notable milestones

rag_queries.expected_answer: Lists three notable baseball records with holders

rag_queries.query: How does the strike zone work in baseball?
rag_queries.expected_answer: Explains strike zone dimensions and application
grounding_rules: Should describe height and horizontal boundaries

hybrid_queries.query: What's Mike Trout's 2024 home run total and how does that rank historically?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Trout's 2024 HR count and contextualizes against historical records
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_player_stat_split for current stats
Must cite document source (history_records_achievements) for context
Should clearly separate fact (tool) from context (doc)

hybrid_queries.query: Did the Red Sox win today and how important is winning streaks in baseball?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: States game result and explains winning streaks concept
grounding_rules: Must cite tool for game result
Must cite document for strategy/history context

hybrid_queries.query: What's Shohei Ohtani's current pitching stats and how do modern analytics evaluate pitchers?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Ohtani's stats and explains sabermetrics for pitchers
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_player_stat_split for pitching stats
Must cite document for sabermetrics explanation
Should mention metrics like ERA or WAR

hybrid_queries.query: List Yankees games this month and explain how the infield fly rule affects gameplay
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Yankees schedule and explains infield fly rule mechanics
grounding_rules: Must cite document for rule explanation

hybrid_queries.query: How many home runs did Aaron Judge hit in 2024 and what's the all-time home run record?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Judge's 2024 HR total and names all-time record holder
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_player_stat_split for Judge's stats
Must cite document for all-time record
Should put stats in historical context

hybrid_queries.query: What's Clayton Kershaw's ERA this season and how does ERA as a metric work?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Kershaw's ERA and explains the metric
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_player_stat_split for Kershaw's ERA
Could cite document for sabermetrics context
Should explain ERA calculation or significance

hybrid_queries.query: Which MLB divisions exist today and show me a sample team from each?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Describes division structure and provides team examples
grounding_rules: Must cite document for division structure
Could cite tool or knowledge for team examples

hybrid_queries.query: What's the Dodgers' record this season and how has consistency been important to their World Series wins?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides current record and discusses Dodgers' championship consistency
grounding_rules: Must cite tool or schedule for current record
Must cite document for World Series history
Should connect recent performance to historical success

hybrid_queries.query: Show Bryce Harper's stats and explain how modern analytics changed how teams evaluate hitters
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides Harper's stats and discusses sabermetrics impact
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_player_stat_split for recent stats
Must cite document for sabermetrics/analytics explanation

hybrid_queries.query: What was the score of the last Yankees game and how unusual would a score like that be?
hybrid_queries.expected_answer: Provides recent Yankees score and contextualizes its significance
grounding_rules: Must cite tool:get_game_summary for recent game
Should provide analysis of score significance
